DOI:10.24963/kr.2023/1.tldr: It is shown that given countably infinite atomic propositions in the language, Hamming distance is not merely an example, but grounded for two arguably most important conditional logics, Lewis' VC and VCU.

DOI:10.4204/eptcs.306.9.tldr: The implementation in the lazy-grounding ASP system Alpha supports heuristic directives under a novel semantics for declarative specifications of domain-specific heuristics in Answer Set Programming (ASP), providing the first implementation for incorporating declaratively specified domain- specific heURistics in a lazy-Grounding setting.

DOI:10.1109/lics56636.2023.10175737.tldr: A further generalization is presented, which encompasses all previously studied variants of simplicial models and defines a new semantics for epistemic logic with distributed knowledge, where a group of agents may distinguish two worlds, even though each individual agent in the group is unable to distinguish them.

DOI:10.24963/kr.2020/61.tldr: This paper studies an extension of ALC with a rich integer domain that allows for comparisons, and proves that consistency can be solved using automata-theoretic techniques in single exponential time, and thus has no higher worst-case complexity than standard ALC.

213b44371073ff786aab0f6b967aef52c8f0a671.tldr: The notion of least general generalisation is introduced, which generalises simultaneously least common subsumer and concept matching and demonstrates that a finite minimal complete set of generalisations for EL concepts always exists and establishes complexity bounds for computing them.

DOI:10.1145/2933575.2934516.tldr: This work gives a computationally adequate denotational semantics to the language FPC (simply typed lambda calculus extended with recursive types), modelling recursive types using guarded recursive types.

1f548ee1a3d356f3eafc547f99a0c6ea12067edf.tldr: This paper investigates how compilation-based technique can be enhanced by deferring the evaluation of rules generating large number of atoms, and so enabling atoms to be discovered lazily during solving, and demonstrates significant performance improvements over traditional compilation-based solvers.

DOI:10.1109/lics.2019.8785677.tldr: It is shown that these morphisms capture notions of simulation between empirical models obtained via “free” operations in a resource theory of contextuality, including the type of classical control used in measurement-based quantum computation schemes.

eea1c3b9690104aec060c88f785dd7f9170fa8ab.tldr: A signature extension approach to generate seed signatures for modularization and uniform interpolation of OWL ontologies, both of which are ontology abstraction techniques, and an empirical evaluation shows that the proposed method outperforms other term selection baselines in making accurate selections.

DOI:10.1007/978-3-030-53288-8_23.tldr: The soundness of this rewriter-based method is proved using the ACL2 theorem prover, and it can verify integer multiplier designs with various architectures automatically, including Wallace, Dadda, and 4-to-2 compressor trees.

DOI:10.1109/lics56636.2023.10175688.tldr: The theory of 2-categorical fixpoint operators is developed where the 2-dimensional framework allows to model the execution steps for languages with (co)inductive principles.

DOI:10.24963/kr.2024/27.tldr: Modular calculi for the logics for nonmonotonic reasoning defined by Kraus, Lehmann, and Magidor are introduced, featuring a strengthened form of analyticity and a more effective semantics for C.

d4ffa144d15092cb962abb208f7299d08ba32a6d.tldr: A novel automata-theoretic characterisation of timeline-based planning is presented where the existence of a plan is shown to be equivalent to the nonemptiness of the language recognised by a nondeterministic finite-state automaton that suitably encodes all the problem constraints (timelines and synchronisation rules).

DOI:10.1145/3209108.3209205.tldr: It is shown that every satisfiable formula has a model of at most doubly exponential size and argued that the satisfiability (= finite satisfiability) problem for this logic is 2-ExpTime-complete.

308f866fd518103cdaa7ad2611484fd84fab8579.tldr: In this homeworks, if a problem requires you to come up with an algorithm, you should prove its correctness as well as state and prove its asymptotic running time.

DOI:10.1145/3209108.3209163.tldr: This work defines two classes of functions, called regular and first-order list functions, which manipulate objects such as lists, which are exactly the same as first- order transductions, under a suitable encoding of the inputs.

DOI:10.1145/2933575.2935319.tldr: A unified categorical framework for investigating healthiness conditions is contributed, based on a dual adjunction induced by a dualizing object and on the notion of relative Eilenberg-Moore algebra.

DOI:10.1007/978-3-319-55014-5_7.tldr: An answer set programming based method that detects and repairs conflicts between treatments, and includes the possibility to take preferences based on drug-drug interactions into account while solving inconsistencies.

f61b1cb7ecf348895583f71d84347e813d6af63f.tldr: A new temporal extension of the logic of Hereand-There and its equilibria obtained by combining it with dynamic logic over (linear) traces is proposed, known as Linear Dynamic Equilibrium Logic, or simply DEL.

DOI:10.1109/lics.2019.8785699.tldr: It is proved that both extensions of the $\lambda$ -calculus with a probabilistic choice operator enjoys confluence and standardization, in an extended way: these two fundamental notions are revisited to take into account the asymptotic behaviour of terms.

d7cfcc1d2ffb5d8a06f93e0ec578b887a346fc81.tldr: CoVerD is introduced, an $L_0$ robustness verifier that selects between different candidate coverings without constructing them, but by predicting their block size distribution, which relies on a theorem providing closed-form expressions for the mean and variance of this distribution.

DOI:10.1007/978-3-030-53291-8_30.tldr: A new variant of the policy gradient algorithm that can incorporate feedback from a deduction engine into the underlying statistical model is proposed that combines the power of deductive and statistical reasoning in a unified framework.

DOI:10.1109/lics56636.2023.10175691.tldr: It is shown how to compute the linear hull, and thus it is decidable whether or not a given automaton over a number field is equivalent to a deterministic one.
